snippet_primary: "I've been a long-time customer of Envato, which is why the new GenAI plans are particularly disappointing. Limiting users to just 10 generations feels out of touch with how these tools are actually used.  Competitors like Kling and Google clearly offer more value for the price. When I reached out for clarification, the response I received was essentially: this is the plan, take it or leave it."
